clusters.label: Backpropagation
clusters.rationale: Backpropagation is a distinct algorithm for computing gradients via chain rule; no other candidate covers this specific algorithm.

clusters.label: Activation Functions
clusters.rationale: Activation functions are a distinct component of neural networks; other candidates cover loss, training, etc.

clusters.label: Loss Functions
clusters.rationale: Loss functions are a separate teachable concept from activation functions and optimization.

clusters.label: Overfitting and Regularization
clusters.rationale: Overfitting and dropout are a distinct topic from accuracy or training implementation.

clusters.label: Linear Algebra Foundations
clusters.rationale: Linear algebra fundamentals underpin neural networks but are a separate math concept.

clusters.label: Gradient Descent Optimization
clusters.rationale: Gradient descent is the optimization algorithm distinct from backpropagation (gradient computation) and training loop implementation.

clusters.label: Neural Network Training Implementation
clusters.rationale: The overall training loop with initialization and caching is broader than individual steps like backprop or gradient descent, thus a distinct concept.

clusters.label: Data Preparation for Neural Networks
clusters.rationale: Data encoding and feature/target identification is a distinct data preprocessing step not to be confused with model evaluation splitting.

clusters.label: Divisão Treino/Teste
clusters.rationale: Train/test split is a separate evaluation technique from data encoding and from accuracy metric.

clusters.label: Implementação Manual vs Bibliotecas
clusters.rationale: Comparing manual vs library implementation is a tool-specific topic unrelated to core concepts like activation or loss.

clusters.label: Acurácia
clusters.rationale: Accuracy as an evaluation metric is distinct from overfitting and from training procedures.
